entries.title: Your first mate tells you when Automatic leaves a computer out
entries.body: A project that names no computer requirements runs only on computers like this one. When you add a computer with a different chip or system, such as an Intel Mac mini beside an Apple-silicon Mac, your first mate now says so once for each project and offers the one change that lets it run there. It also says when a computer is missing a program a project needs, or cannot reach the project. Settings → Devices shows each computer's chip, and a task's Details say why a computer was left out.
